pages.text: Today was very cold. A stove burned inside the shop.
Gugu wanted to warm up beside it. One wooden chair stood in front.
Gugu hopped onto the chair and spread both wings, taking all the space.
Nono asked, "May we sit too?" Gugu did not move. "No. This is my seat."
The two sat in a far corner, pressed close together.
Only the side facing the stove was warm. Gugu's back kept feeling cold.
Grandpa Badger asked, "Who is warming your back?"
Gugu folded both wings. "Friends, let us sit together."
All three sat snugly on the chair. Tummies warm, backs warm too.
